Overview

Tuscaloosa is a city in AL with a population of 100,000. Home of the University of Alabama, with a lively college atmosphere and affordable housing. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.2.
